parsed.explanation: No criminalisation of trans identity, retained gender-reassignment discrimination protection, working courts and no documented trans-specific violence: the baseline is far from catastrophic. But the dossier documents tier-1 universal exposures in force: a statutory single-sex-spaces code (Aug 2026), birth-sex strip-search policy, birth-sex custody placement after the 2026 ruling, and ward-exclusion plans plus a documented trans patient's fatal ward removal (Joelle). Rule of law operates, but partly against trans people here, so it doesn't mitigate those. Social hostility and hostile media raise outing friction, offset by tolerant general polls and large LGBT communities. Worst feature is tier 1 with no shown working remedy → Elevated Risk.
